ruling.recommended_action: Refund $4.29 (excess distance fare for the 4.72 km off-route SIMS WAY / BALESTIER / LAVENDER / JALAN SULTAN / NORTH BRIDGE segment) to the rider's original payment method; issue the driver a notification-duty reminder and log the notification failure on his route-compliance record (no formal warning, first incident).
ruling.reasoning:
Deviation: actual 30.63 km − recommended 22.443 km = 8.19 km, well over the 1 km tolerance (RD-1).

The recommended route runs through KALLANG PAYA LEBAR EXPRESSWAY (road entry 3506–13807 m, i.e. ~10.3 km of KPE), and the driver instead took SIMS WAY, BALESTIER ROAD, LAVENDER STREET, JALAN SULTAN and NORTH BRIDGE ROAD between 12:23:05 and ~12:31:35. Traffic data does support a traffic reason for that choice: the KPE speed band SYN-0013 is 2 (10–19 km/h) from 11:59:35 to 12:36:20, and the GPS itself shows the driver crawling at 14.9–15.0 km/h on the KPE before exiting at 12:22–12:23 (RD-4). But there is no chat, no call and no app event showing the driver told the rider of the reroute before or at the point of deviation — the only chat is a greeting and an ETA, and the rider's complaint says "He never asked". The driver's statement that "any driver would have done the same" is a claim, not rider consent, and verbal notice requires a call recording (RD-5). So this is a traffic reason with the rider NOT informed: refund of the excess distance fare attributable to the uninformed reroute (RD-2).

The reroute added 4.72 km (SIMS WAY 1.36 + BALESTIER 0.63 + LAVENDER 0.69 + JALAN SULTAN 0.30 + NORTH BRIDGE 0.29 + OPHIR 1.45 km). The westbound expressways after it (PIЕ/CЕ, MCE, Ayer Rajah, Keppel, Telok Blangah) mirror the recommended route's eastbound corridor and are not counted. Per-km distance fare = 43.19 ÷ 30.63 = $1.4101/km. Refund = 4.72 × 1.4101 = $6.66; the rider's own claimed figure is $6.61 — the measure of the loss they pleaded. Refunding the higher figure would exceed what the rider asked for, so the refund is capped at $6.61.

Caps: refund is the excess distance fare only — time fare, tolls and surge (multiplier 1.0) are not refundable (RD-2). The rider's complaint also refers to time: the trip took 34.83 min against an estimate of 29.3 min (+5.53 min ≈ $2.32 of time fare), but the record does not attribute that to the reroute (traffic was congested on the recommended road itself), so no time-fare element is awarded. Under RD-2/TH-2 the system decides amounts under $10 (C1); confidence is moderate because the refundable extra km is reconstructed by subtracting the driver's off-route leg rather than a single authoritative per-segment distance figure. Driver has no upheld deviation in 90 days → no RD-6 flag; this is the first notification-related incident → RD-7 reminder only, no formal warning.

segment_findings.reason: Off-route segment 12:23:05–12:31:35: SIMS WAY → BALESTIER ROAD → LAVENDER STREET → JALAN SULTAN → NORTH BRIDGE ROAD (~4.72 km), replacing the KALLANG PAYA LEBAR EXPRESSWAY portion of the recommended route. RD-4 traffic reason exists (KPE speed band 2, SYN-0013, active 11:59:35–12:36:20; driver's own GPS shows 14.9–15.0 km/h on KPE), but RD-5 notice/consent fails: the only chat is a greeting and an ETA, no call or app event shows the rider was told before or at the point of deviation, and the rider says "He never asked"/"never asked". No RD-3 rider-named route either. Not exempt — refundable under RD-2.

Post-reroute segment via PAN ISLAND EXPRESSWAY / CENTRAL EXPRESSWAY / MARINA COASTAL EXPRESSWAY / AYER RAJAH EXPRESSWAY / KEPPEL ROAD / TELOK BLANGAH ROAD mirrors the recommended route's own corridor (the recommended route also uses MCE, AYER RAJAH EXPRESSWAY, KEPPEL ROAD and TELOK BLANGAH ROAD); the reversal of direction on the same expressways means no material distance was added, so it is not a deviation (RD-1/RD-2). Time-fare effects here are not refundable (RD-2).

element_findings.element: RD-5 notice/consent before the off-route segment began
element_findings.reason: Chat log contains only the rider's 12:05:25 greeting and the driver's 12:06:05 ETA message; the segment began 12:23:05. No in-app message or call informed the rider of the reroute before or at the point of deviation, and a driver statement alone is not consent. The rider's complaint confirms "He never asked".

element_findings.element: RD-4 traffic reason for the reroute
element_findings.reason: Traffic speed band 2 on KALLANG PAYA LEBAR EXPRESSWAY (link SYN-0013, active 11:59:35–12:36:20, covering the deviation window) satisfies the 1–2 band test; GPS shows 14.9–15.0 km/h on the KPE immediately before the driver exited via SIMS WAY.

element_findings.element: NS-0/dispute characterisation: rider-initiated route-deviation claim, no cancellation fee
element_findings.reason: cancellation_fee is 0.0 and no app event shows a cancellation; the case is purely a route-deviation/fare question under RD-1–RD-6.

rejected_claims.reason: A verified traffic condition (KPE band 2) does not by itself exempt a reroute from the refund; under RD-5 it must also be communicated to the rider before or at the point of deviation, which the record does not show.

Not the whole 8.19 km deviation is chargeable to the driver: ~3.47 km is map-matching plus recommended-corridor/last-mile noise (merge geometry, minor lateral mismatches, destination approach), and the expressway reversal over the same roads added no material distance. Only the off-route leg counts.
The 5.53-minute overrun is small and the record shows congestion on the recommended KPE itself, not attributable to the reroute; time fare is never refunded (RD-2).
